name: proj-change-request-form
description: Turns a "small" ask into a sized change request with impact on time, cost, scope, quality and risk, the options (accept, defer, swap, reject) with a named decider and date, and a change log entry. Use for "run proj-change-request-form", "it's just one small change", "write a change request", "scope creep from the client", "size this new request", "how do I push back on this ask", "change control", "update the change log", part of the AI for Project Management Pack by 90n.
